package http

type AccessScopes[M any] struct{}
type Permission[M any] struct{}
type Endpoint[R any] struct{}
type Route[P any] struct{}
type Scope struct{}
type Middleware func()
type Registration struct{}
type Authentication struct{}
type Guard[M any] struct{}
type GuardBinding[M any] struct{}
type TicketRedeemer struct{}

type bindingOption[M any] interface{ apply(M) }
type RequirementOption[M any] interface {
	bindingOption[M]
	requirement()
}
type ActorOption[M any] interface {
	bindingOption[M]
	actor()
}
type GuardAlternative[M any] struct{}

type req[M any] struct{}

func (req[M]) apply(M)      {}
func (req[M]) requirement() {}

type act[M any] struct{}

func (act[M]) apply(M) {}
func (act[M]) actor()  {}

func Scopes[M any](AccessScopes[M]) RequirementOption[M]       { return req[M]{} }
func Permissions[M any](...Permission[M]) RequirementOption[M] { return req[M]{} }
func ActorMiddleware[M any](...Middleware) ActorOption[M]      { return act[M]{} }
func AllOf[M any](...RequirementOption[M]) GuardAlternative[M] { return GuardAlternative[M]{} }

type AuthenticatedEndpoint[R, M any] struct{}

func (AuthenticatedEndpoint[R, M]) Handle(func()) Registration { return Registration{} }

type AuthenticatedRoute[P, M any] struct{}

func (AuthenticatedRoute[P, M]) Handle(func()) Registration { return Registration{} }

type TicketEndpoint[R, M any] struct{}

func (TicketEndpoint[R, M]) Handle(func()) Registration { return Registration{} }

type AccessRule[M any] interface{ rule(M) }

func (GuardAlternative[M]) rule(M)                      {}
func AnyOf[M any](...GuardAlternative[M]) AccessRule[M] { return GuardAlternative[M]{} }
func (GuardBinding[M]) AnyActor() AccessRule[M]         { return GuardAlternative[M]{} }

func Authenticated[R, M any](Endpoint[R], GuardBinding[M], AccessRule[M], ...ActorOption[M]) AuthenticatedEndpoint[R, M] {
	return AuthenticatedEndpoint[R, M]{}
}
func RequireAuthentication[R, M any](Endpoint[R], *Authentication, Guard[M], AccessRule[M], ...ActorOption[M]) AuthenticatedEndpoint[R, M] {
	return AuthenticatedEndpoint[R, M]{}
}
func RequireRouteAuthentication[P, M any](Route[P], *Authentication, Guard[M], AccessRule[M], ...ActorOption[M]) AuthenticatedRoute[P, M] {
	return AuthenticatedRoute[P, M]{}
}
func TicketAuthenticated[R, M any](Endpoint[R], GuardBinding[M], TicketRedeemer, AccessRule[M], ...ActorOption[M]) TicketEndpoint[R, M] {
	return TicketEndpoint[R, M]{}
}
func ConfigureAuthenticated[R, M any](e AuthenticatedEndpoint[R, M], _ ...ActorOption[M]) AuthenticatedEndpoint[R, M] {
	return e
}
func ConfigureAuthenticatedRoute[P, M any](r AuthenticatedRoute[P, M], _ ...ActorOption[M]) AuthenticatedRoute[P, M] {
	return r
}
